description: Machine-readable licence policy for the Atlas runtime closure. Consumed by scripts/check_licenses.py and scripts/generate_third_party_notices.py. The runtime closure is defined solely by compliance/runtime-manifest.json (the A0 partition rule); this file records the reviewed conclusion for every member and every nested/static/native component, with SPDX semantics: OR requires a recorded election, AND preserves every obligation, WITH carries the exception. Nothing here grants, limits, or interprets any right in Atlas itself - Atlas-owned terms are out of scope for this file (Stage A2b).

elections.rationale: cryptography's own dual licence; the Apache-2.0 arm is elected and its full text ships in the distribution (LICENSE.APACHE).
Rust crates offering MIT or Apache-2.0; the MIT arm is elected; canonical MIT text supplied, attribution by crate name and version.
same disjunction written in the opposite order; the MIT arm is elected.
cryptography's own Rust crates carry the parent's dual licence; the same Apache-2.0 arm is elected for consistency.

reviewed_components.mechanism: LGPL-2.1 section 6(a): complete corresponding source is stored in this repository and ships beside any distribution; the same materials are published at the distribution location (also satisfying 6(d)); the component remains a separately identifiable, replaceable pure-Python package. Election recorded here; wording of the licence-side affirmative permission is an A2b/legal item (A2B-REQ-1).

reviewed_components.security_interlock: security/vulnerability-exceptions.json pins paramiko==4.0.0 (PYSEC-2026-2858, expires 2026-10-18); a paramiko upgrade must update BOTH files or both gates fail.

reviewed_components.mechanism: identical to paramiko (LGPL-2.1 section 6(a) + 6(d)); additionally the distribution ships only a 727-byte short notice, so the notices generator supplies the canonical full LGPL-2.1 text and records that it did so. Required at import time by netmiko (netmiko/__init__.py -> scp_handler -> import scp); not removable.

reviewed_components.mechanism: MPL-2.0 sections 3.1/3.2(a): the Covered Software's Source Code Form is stored in this repository and ships beside any distribution; because fqdn is pure Python distributed as source, an unfrozen layout carries the Source Code Form by construction. Atlas modifies no MPL-covered file, so exact upstream source satisfies the obligation and no Atlas-owned file becomes Covered Software.

spdx.notes: families are matched as parsed SPDX symbols, never substrings. A forbidden symbol appearing as one arm of a disjunction whose other arm is elected and allowed does NOT make the component forbidden; the original expression is preserved and the election is recorded.
